name: Invitation suite
line: Your invitation, details card and reply card set out as letterpress paper on a dark linen table, with photographs laid among them.

name: Photo story
line: Big, full-width photographs carry your story, with the day, travel and RSVP set quietly in between on a dark page.

name: Guest guide
line: A clean printed itinerary: the wedding hour by hour with times in large type, then getting here, where to stay and RSVP.
